agent_json.root_cause: The GIF background color index (SBackGroundColor) is read from the file as an unchecked byte value in DGifGetScreenDesc (dgif_lib.c:259), written into every pixel of the screen buffer in GIF2RGB (gif2rgb.c:394-395), and then used as a direct array index into ColorMap->Colors[] in DumpScreen2RGB (gif2rgb.c:304,327) without any bounds check. If the background color index exceeds the color map size (ColorCount = 1 << BitsPerPixel, max 256), a heap-based buffer over-read occurs.
agent_json.evidence: dgif_lib.c:259: GifFile->SBackGroundColor = Buf[1]; // raw byte, no validation. gif2rgb.c:394-395: ScreenBuffer[0][i] = GifFile->SBackGroundColor; // assigned to all pixels. gif2rgb.c:304: ColorMapEntry = &ColorMap->Colors[GifRow[j]]; // unchecked index into heap-allocated color map array. The global color map size is (1 << BitsPerPixel) where BitsPerPixel = (Buf[0] & 0x07) + 1, so a crafted GIF can specify a Background Color Index larger than the color map entry count.
